# SOOS

> SOOS is an Application Security Posture Management platform providing comprehensive vulnerability scanning, compliance integration, and CI/CD pipeline automation.

SOOS offers integrated security scanning capabilities including SCA, SAST, DAST, and container scanning with seamless CI/CD integrations for GitHub and other platforms. The platform enables teams to manage security posture, track vulnerabilities, and automate compliance workflows through third-party integrations like Vanta.

## Key Topics

- Application Security Posture Management
- CI/CD Integrations
- SCA Scanning
- DAST Scanning
- SAST Scanning
- Container Scanning
- GitHub Integration
- SBOM Manager
- Vanta Integration
- Security Scanning
- Vulnerability Management
- Compliance Automation
- Pipeline Configuration
- Issue Management
- Notification Integrations
